title: C2PA Cameras Do Not Survive Contact with Reality
summary: This article examines the practical limitations of C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) implementation in cameras, revealing that the content authenticity metadata fails to survive common real-world scenarios like basic image editing or format conversion. The author conducted hands-on testing to expose the gap between C2PA's promised capabilities and actual functionality.
problem_solved: Exposes why C2PA cameras fail to deliver reliable content authenticity verification in practice.
why_valuable: Highlights critical flaws in digital content provenance standards that are increasingly important for combating AI-generated misinformation.
